headline: Boeing does not rule out more layoffs amid stagnation of its production plans
summary: Boeing declined to confirm whether more job cuts are planned after its next round of reductions next month. The company faces pressure from one of its major unions.
why: Boeing is a major US aerospace manufacturer and a key supplier of commercial aircraft, so its production rate and workforce decisions affect airlines and suppliers.

impacts.name: Boeing
impacts.why: Possible further job cuts relate to stalled production plans and union pressure at the aircraft maker.
